description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which provides high-level CRUD operations for managing notes in a notes application. It interacts with the NotesDatabase class to perform database operations for Note objects.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A high-level repository class for managing notes which provides methods for fetching, retrieving, adding, saving, and removing notes from the database.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the database.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: removeNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database by its ID.
